messages.subject: How to improve memory
parts:
Hi,
 
I am curious to know how to improve the memory of the prog when I get the following warning during clustering of an example dataset ():
 
"The call to hclust appears to have failed. This is often due, as is the case here, to running out of memory as hclust is rather memory hungry. A quick solution is to sample the dataset, through the Data tab. On 32bit machines you may be limited to less than 2000 observations. Rattle 2.6.26 77".
 
I have to handle a huge dataset (50,000 x 50) in future.
 
Thanks a lot in advance.
Ramesh

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: How to improve memory
parts:
R is in-memory analytics. On 64 bit Windows with plenty of RAM you can load plenty more data.

On Ubuntu with 32GB RAM, for example, I can readily process 2 million observations by 1000 columns.

Extensive processing and model building may need 2 or 3 times that memory.

The more RAM the better, once you start talking about bigger datasets.

Graham Williams
http://togaware.com
